correctness.rationale: An explicit invariant-space decomposition gives the full Liouvillian characteristic polynomial with the correct multiplicities. Its guaranteed negative real root, viewed as a quadratic relation in gamma, yields the exact upper bound by a nonnegative discriminant; factorization at gamma* proves attainment and strictness elsewhere. Routh–Hurwitz confirms the unique stationary eigenvalue. A fresh directly assembled full-Liouvillian checker passed 264 checks for n=3..8, without substituting finite numerics for the proof.

The result supplies a sharp all-size optimum for a natural intrinsic operator invariant and its nontrivial scaling gamma*~nJ while the maximized gap tends J; this is not an arbitrary finite parameter table or routine normalization check. The result explicitly separates asymptotic spectral relaxation from finite-time operational performance.
